signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Be the voice of our scientists. More than 100 scientists use our platform every day. You'll talk with dozens of them each week, find where their work gets harder than it should…
Be the voice of operations. Running a large scientific team means tracking progress, staffing projects, and knowing what each one needs. You'll understand those challenges…
Own outcomes, not just features. You'll define the metrics that matter and work with engineering to move them, framing work by impact so the team spends its effort where it counts…
